instruction: What is the title of the newest released song in my Spotify account from across my song, album and playlist libraries?
notes: Read-only question task (evaluation requires no DB changes), so every action is a lookup. supervisor.show_profile supplies the Spotify username (email) and show_account_passwords the password; login yields the token. The three library listings (song, album, playlist; paginated in practice) each set a scanned flag. The newest song can only be identified after all three are gathered, so spotify-show-song requires all three flags; it abstracts both the per-song release_date lookups (for song-library and playlist songs; album songs take the album's release_date) and the final title lookup of the arg-max song. The static title-of fact links the answer song to its title object; complete_task passes that title as the answer and is forced last by (not (task-completed)) on all actions.
